verification: Commit resolved with git ls-remote; SHA256 and byte lengths computed from raw HTTP response bytes at the pinned commit, not from reformatted text.
implementation_relationship: Independent CSI/HPE mechanism adaptations, not an unchanged or byte-identical reproduction of BackdoorBench classification pipelines. This manifest vendors no upstream source code.

common.checkpoint_selection: Final live model, not minimum-clean-loss or original-model fallback

fp.ranking: Mean signed input activation of a linear head
fp.selection: Last pruning step within relative clean-accuracy tolerance, stopping at the first failure; source uses clean TEST

nad.attention_normalization: Channel-summed absolute activation powers divided by their spatial L2 norm plus 1e-6; MSE attention loss
nad.teacher_scheduler: CosineAnnealingLR T_max=100, stepped per epoch for ten teacher epochs
nad.student_scheduler: Manual epoch LR: configured lr before epoch 2, 0.01 at epochs 2-19, 0.0001 from epoch 20; default ten student epochs therefore use 0.01
nad.unused_yaml_fields: epochs=100 does not set the NAD student loop length; momentum/weight_decay aliases do not replace sgd_momentum/wd in the optimizer factory

ft_sam.note: Equal rho_min/rho_max keep radius at 2.0; alpha zero disables the source gradient-decomposition correction

common: HPELi CSI-to-pose regression replaces image classification. MPJPE replaces cross-entropy, while clean repair-selection error replaces accuracy only for the FP stopping criterion.
Repair starts from audited, complete epoch-49 T1 checkpoints. The original victim, trigger, poison identities and T1-T3 files remain immutable.

A shared trusted-clean bank uses at most 5% of original TRAIN frames per seed, split into sequence-disjoint repair-fit and repair-selection partitions. The original victim may already have seen these TRAIN observations.

Official TEST is neither a repair loader nor a hyperparameter-selection set. All defenses retain their final scheduled checkpoint; full TEST is scored after repair. No initial-epoch or clean-best fallback is used.

Numerical optimizer, epoch, batch, FP-step, NAD-beta and SAM-radius defaults follow the pinned configs and operative source code. HPE layer mapping, clean-bank grouping, loss and FP utility semantics are explicit task adaptations, not optimized defenses.

There are no class labels or meaningful classification label-smoothing targets in pose regression. The common sequence-balanced, sequence-disjoint clean bank replaces image/class-oriented subset handling; RGB augmentations are not applied to CSI.
Windows repair/evaluation loaders use zero subprocess workers as a new T5 execution policy; no worker policy in the frozen original experiments is changed.

ft.name: Clean fine-tuning
ft.mechanism: Optimize the inherited victim on trusted clean inputs and true pose labels.
ft.adaptation: Full HPE parameter fine-tuning with source numerical defaults and MPJPE, without RGB augmentation or class sampling. The final scheduled model is retained.

fp.name: Fine-Pruning
fp.paper_title: Fine-Pruning: Defending Against Backdooring Attacks on Deep Neural Networks
fp.mechanism: Rank model features by clean activation, suppress the least-active features, then fine-tune.
fp.adaptation: Mask input columns of HPE final linear regression.7, ranked by signed mean activation, using source 1%-step counts. Replace source clean-TEST accuracy loss with clean-TRAIN-selection relative MPJPE increase within 10%, stopping at first failure. Fix the source off-by-one mask slice and mutable-candidate alias explicitly. Retain the final fine-tuned model. This is not pruning every backbone convolutional channel.

nad.name: Neural Attention Distillation
nad.paper_title: Neural Attention Distillation: Erasing Backdoor Triggers from Deep Neural Networks
nad.mechanism: Fine-tune a teacher on trusted clean data, freeze it, and repair an original-victim student with attention-transfer and clean-task losses.
nad.adaptation: Map the three source attention positions to HPE skunit1, skunit2 and regression.5, retain source betas [500,1000,1000], p=2 and norm-plus-1e-6 normalization, and replace the clean class loss with MPJPE. Teacher and original-victim student each run the operative source ten epochs; use final teacher and final student, not clean-best checkpoints.

ft_sam.name: FT-SAM
ft_sam.paper_title: Enhancing Fine-Tuning Based Backdoor Defense with Sharpness-Aware Minimization
ft_sam.mechanism: Use two forward/backward passes: a weight-adaptive perturbation maximizing clean loss locally, followed by an update at restored weights.
ft_sam.adaptation: An independent weight-adaptive two-pass update retains source radius 2.0, alpha zero, SGD defaults and the operative per-minibatch cosine scheduler. MPJPE replaces label-smoothed classification cross-entropy; no artificial pose classes or class-balanced labels are introduced. Retain the final model.

licenses.third_party_notice: The repository explicitly excepts third-party components with their own terms. Its repository license must not be assumed to cover every dependency or original author implementation.
licenses.attribution: Retain attribution to BackdoorBench and the original defense authors when using the relevant methods. A source audit is not endorsement by those authors or a legal review.

limits: Pinned provenance establishes what was inspected, not that a CSI/HPE adaptation is empirically effective.
The local implementation and tests do not by themselves establish a full MM-Fi defense result or statistical superiority.
FT, FP, NAD and FT-SAM are four representative model-repair settings, not coverage of all BackdoorBench defenses or detection methods.
